skill.name: azure-ai-voicelive-java
skill.description: Real-time, bidirectional voice conversations with AI assistants using WebSocket technology.

generated_query: I need to build a real-time voice assistant for my Java application. Users should be able to speak naturally, and the AI should respond in the Alloy voice with 24kHz PCM audio. I want to handle interruptions and end-of-speech detection automatically – silence of 500ms should trigger the response. Also, I’d like to use DefaultAzureCredential for authentication. Could you show me how to start a session, configure these options, send audio chunks, and capture the response audio events?

edit_instructions.target_text:
### DefaultAzureCredential (Recommended)

```java
import com.azure.identity.DefaultAzureCredentialBuilder;

VoiceLiveAsyncClient client = new VoiceLiveClientBuilder()
    .endpoint(System.getenv("AZURE_VOICELIVE_ENDPOINT"))
    .credential(new DefaultAzureCredentialBuilder().build())
    .buildAsyncClient();
```
